cc:Work.dc:description: Ideal-air illustrative model, not Tesla data. Different fixed nozzle areas give the same initial 10 kN. Regulated 3 MPa nozzle stays at 10 kN for 1.322 s; direct tank nozzle drops below 8 kN after 0.305 s. Both curves stop at 3 MPa tank pressure; the direct tail is not rated 10 kN service. Shaded areas integrate their different service intervals.
